create_gaudi_text_generation_pipeline: create a GaudiTextGenerationPipeline instance with a model, tokenizer, and generation config for HPU-accelerated text generation
run_text_generation_with_pipeline: run text generation by calling the GaudiTextGenerationPipeline with a prompt string or list of prompts
configure_sampling_parameters: configure temperature and top_p sampling parameters on the pipeline via args.do_sample settings
enable_langchain_compatibility: enable Langchain-compatible output format by setting use_with_langchain to return generated_text dictionaries
warmup_hpu_graphs: warm up HPU graph compilation on pipeline initialization by running dummy prompts before real inference
